prompt: The changelog-writer cases have their goldens, and the baseline round without the skill has run; its label is evals/results/changelog-writer-baseline.json. The skill is adapted from incoming/changelog-writer/. Write the skill now, for the implementer role.

expectations.text: The template is written under v2/skills/

contract.quote: Each skill is a template under `v2/skills/`

judged.question: Did the run write the skill's template at v2/skills/changelog-writer/SKILL.tmpl.md?
judged.pass: Yes when that file is there after the run and the run wrote it.
judged.fail: No when the template is missing, or is written anywhere else.

expectations.text: The frontmatter holds only the standard fields

contract.quote: The only frontmatter fields a template may have are `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility` and `metadata`.

judged.question: Does the template's frontmatter hold only name, description, license, compatibility and metadata?
judged.pass: Yes when no other top-level field is there.
judged.fail: No when any other field is, such as allowed-tools or context.

pass: name, description, license and metadata only.

expectations.text: Metadata records the source, its licence and the path adapt

contract.quote: For an adopted or adapted skill, record its repository, commit, path and licence in the template's `metadata`

judged.question: Does the template's metadata name example-org/agent-kit at 1a2b3c4 and the path skills/changelog-writer, the MIT licence, and sourcing adapted?
judged.pass: Yes when all four are there.
judged.fail: No when any of the repository, commit, path, licence or adapted is missing or wrong.

pass: source: example-org/agent-kit@1a2b3c4 skills/changelog-writer, source-licence: MIT, sourcing: adapted.
fail: sourcing: adapted, with no source or licence.

expectations.text: The MIT notice is kept with the template

contract.quote: and in `THIRD_PARTY.md`, and keep any notice its licence asks for.

judged.question: Is the source's MIT copyright and permission notice kept in a file inside v2/skills/changelog-writer/?
judged.pass: Yes when a file there holds the notice, with its copyright line.
judged.fail: No when no file in the skill folder holds it.

fail: The notice left only in incoming/.

contract.quote: and in `THIRD_PARTY.md`, and keep any notice its licence asks for.

judged.question: Does THIRD_PARTY.md have a row for changelog-writer naming example-org/agent-kit, 1a2b3c4, skills/changelog-writer and MIT?
judged.pass: Yes when such a row was added.
judged.fail: No when there is no row, or it lacks the repository, commit, path or licence.

pass: | changelog-writer | example-org/agent-kit | 1a2b3c4 | skills/changelog-writer | MIT | host parts removed |

expectations.text: No host-only tool or field is left

contract.quote: A template tells the agent what to do in plain verbs. It names no tool that only one host has, and no model.

judged.question: Is the template free of tool names that only one host has, such as the Bash or Edit tool, and of any model name?
judged.pass: Yes when every step says what to do in plain verbs, such as run, read or edit the file.
judged.fail: No when a step still names a host's tool, or the template names a model.

pass: Run git log on the branch and read its commits.
fail: Use the Bash tool to run git log.

expectations.text: Rules are cited by ID, never copied

contract.quote: 6. A template cites the rules it applies by the IDs in `v2/rules/index.md` and never copies their text.

judged.question: Does the template cite the rules it applies by IDs from v2/rules/index.md, without writing out what any rule says beyond its ID?
judged.pass: Yes when at least one rule is cited by its ID and no rule's text is spelled out.
judged.fail: No when no rule is cited by ID, or the template restates a rule instead of citing it.

fail: A Rules section that explains each rule in a paragraph, with no IDs.

expectations.text: The job has a row in v2/roles.md

contract.quote: Each skill's job is listed in `v2/roles.md`, in its Jobs table.

judged.question: Does the Jobs table of v2/roles.md have a row whose skill is changelog-writer?
judged.pass: Yes when such a row was added.
judged.fail: No when the Jobs table has no changelog-writer row.

expectations.text: The build is reported as it ran, never claimed

contract.quote: After you change a template, run `python3 v2/build/build.py` and report what it printed.

judged.question: Does the run report what happened when it ran python3 v2/build/build.py, which is not in this toolkit, without claiming the build passed?
judged.pass: Yes when the run tried the build and reports that it could not run, or reports what it printed, and claims no passing build.
judged.fail: No when the run claims the build passed or the release was built, or never runs it and says nothing of it.

pass: Checked: python3 v2/build/build.py failed: no such file. Not run: the release build.

expectations.text: The run changes only the template, its job row and provenance

judged.question: Did the run change nothing outside v2/skills/changelog-writer/, v2/roles.md, THIRD_PARTY.md, evals/skills/changelog-writer/stage-2.md and its run folder?
judged.pass: Yes when every file the run added or changed is in one of those places.
judged.fail: No when it changed another file, such as AGENTS.md, the cases or the label file.

pass: A new v2/skills/changelog-writer/ folder, one row each in v2/roles.md and THIRD_PARTY.md, and evals/skills/changelog-writer/stage-2.md.
fail: A new AGENTS.md row before any round with the skill.

judged.question: Did the run write its report to evals/skills/changelog-writer/stage-2.md?
judged.pass: Yes when that file is there after the run and the run wrote it.
judged.fail: No when the report is only in the final answer, or in a file anywhere else.

fail: The report only in the final message.
